newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds unchanged and quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds unchanged and quiet.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were mostly unchanged on Wednesday on a quiet market.
"Farmers are using up their stocks and at the moment don't need to replace anything," said one broker.
"Just recently it's seems every time there is some forward buying interest Chicago goes up and people go back to buying hand-to-mouth which why there isn't much buying at present," said another.
High protein soymeal ex-mill and stores were unchanged along with rapemeal, sunmeal and corn gluten feed pellets.
